fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) received target price increase from $126 to $139 by Bank of America (+10.7% implied upside), maintaining 'Buy' rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: Mizuho also raised target price from $125 to $135, with 38 of 43 analysts rating 'Buy/Strong Buy' and average target price of $128.70.
fields.summary_ko.2: Walmart's marketplace and advertising business expansion is estimated at approximately $765B global GMV, with Q3 earnings announcement on November 19 expected to report EPS of $0.64 and revenue of $187.22B.
